allowed_public_conclusions: All 16 original upstream-B trials finalized; the frozen result contains 14 known functional and valid completions, zero known functional failures, and two unresolved grading-contract disputes.

All 16 responses satisfy the declared envelope and accurately quote the supplied initial checks. This is finite observed behavior, not a causal estimate of the correction or proof of semantic grader completeness.
Ordinary repair and implementation completed 8/8; seven task pairs succeeded twice. The target difficulty variation was not validated.
The conclusion is robust to every assignment of the two unknowns: 14 known successes already exceed the upper target of 12, and the ordinary failure-control requirement cannot be met.

M/G rejected the two known successful inherited-glob outputs at the deliberately obsolete post-stop check and accepted the two disputed backup outputs. These are secondary stopped-output decisions; unknown correctness remains unknown.
The same report records complete token/call accounting for all 16 attempts but no separate agent-only wall time. No efficiency or dollar-cost inference is supported.

findings.evidence: Each response uses the common-prompt-permitted data-loss kind with exact published case-18 and reachability.py/closure location. Retained executions mark both findings supported. The task obligation allows only incorrect-result and its visible binding omits that restriction. The kind filter alone prevents matching delta-base-retention, producing a contract dispute. Separate case-04 expiry findings match normally.
findings.implication: The disputed rows are unresolved measurement outcomes, not demonstrated model failures, fabricated findings, missing evidence or missed defects. No corrected score was calculated.
findings.prospective_recommendation: Align declared allowed kinds with task-level obligation matching, then test all semantically appropriate kind/location/witness combinations. Any fresh difficulty screen needs separate authorization.

limits: Read-only retained-record and pure arithmetic review. No grader, candidate, model, Docker or new oracle execution; no regrading, source edits, trials or tuning.
Reviewed selected retained source and trial bytes against the exact full-byte audit inventory; full endpoint integrity acceptance is a separate assigned review.
Producer authentication, independent human authorship and live replication are not established by content hashes or this separated AI review.

publication_review.statistical_wording_fix: Changed independent attempts to fresh isolated attempts and stated that repeated trials are not independent task units.

statistical_limits: Eight authored tasks are problem units; two repetitions are not 16 independent tasks.
This is a finite maintainer-run upstream-only development difficulty screen, not a representative population sample, power calculation or held-out efficacy study.
No eval-opt treatment arm ran; no comparison with upstream, causal benefit, effect size, superiority, generality or independent-human-replication claim follows.
Possible completion-count bounds 14 to 16 are missing-outcome assignments, not confidence intervals or corrected grades.
Zero known incorrect kernel acceptances does not establish protection against incorrect outputs: there are no known functional failures and two accepted outcomes remain unresolved.
verdict_scope: Faithful frozen-report interpretation and disclosure of a semantic measurement limitation; not acceptance of grader completeness or difficulty readiness.
